AI & AUTOMATION CONSULTING

Research current premium AI-consulting and enterprise innovation positioning using public websites and authoritative sources.

Study how strong firms communicate:

- AI strategy;
- automation discovery;
- operating-model design;
- vendor/tool selection;
- architecture;
- governance;
- data readiness;
- responsible AI;
- build-versus-buy decisions;
- implementation roadmaps;
- internal-team enablement.

Do not copy wording, proprietary frameworks or layouts.

Create a stronger Silverstone proposition by combining strategy, creative/product design and hands-on implementation.

The consulting service must clearly explain that Silverstone can:

- advise leadership teams and transformation leaders;
- audit workflows, systems and technology estates;
- identify and prioritise valuable AI and automation opportunities;
- recommend tools and platforms;
- help design procurement and vendor-selection criteria;
- develop implementation roadmaps;
- design technical architecture;
- advise on governance, security, data readiness and human oversight;
- conduct workshops and architecture reviews;
- support internal product and engineering teams;
- consult in-house teams developing their own bespoke AI agents;
- consult in-house teams developing their own bespoke automations;
- advise on custom apps, internal platforms and AI-enabled websites;
- move from advisory into implementation when required.

Use premium consulting language without vague management jargon.
